messages:
Ava Ramos: quick pulse for this week's account health check — focusing p95/p99 by route+model and streaming vs non-streaming. sharing the quick table and a few action items.

Jon Patel: thanks — can you paste the raw numbers here? charts are behind the customer dashboard.

Ava Ramos: pasted below. these are 7-day aggregates (Mon-Sun), traffic from eu-west1. p95/p99 are in ms. streaming = realtime websocket streaming, non-streaming = sync HTTP.

Priya Sen: nice, thx. i see a p99 jump on /chat-gen with redwood-large-quant streaming — when did that start?

Ava Ramos: spike started Thu ~03:00 UTC after a config rollout on dedicated pool. looks correlated with higher concurrency on that route.

Ken Wu: can you drop the snippet we use for alert thresholds? i want to double-check the canary policy.

Ava Ramos: sure — current thresholds (org-level):
```
alert_p95_ms = 300
alert_p99_ms = 900
escalation: CS -> Eng -> Infra
```

cs-bot: automatic note: ticket created #INC-8421 (latency spike on /chat-gen streaming) by Ava Ramos.

Jon Patel: raw numbers table:
Route | Model | Mode | p95 | p99 | error_rate | avg_tokens | spend_delta
/chat-gen | redwood-large-quant | streaming | 280ms | 1120ms | 0.6% | 28 | +8%
/chat-gen | redwood-large-quant | sync | 250ms | 860ms | 0.4% | 26 | +3%
/embeddings | embed-base | streaming | 120ms | 220ms | 0.1% | n/a | +1%
/rerank | rerank-v2 | sync | 180ms | 420ms | 0.2% | n/a | -1%
/prompt-svc | redwood-medium | streaming | 95ms | 210ms | 0.05% | 12 | +0%

Priya Sen: ok the biggest delta is /chat-gen streaming p99 (1120ms). error rate also slightly up. do we have logs showing tail latency per shard?

Ava Ramos: eng pulled tail traces — looks like a small subset of requests hit an older kernel fallback on gpu nodes. eng is patching kernel selection to avoid fallback for quantized paths.

Ken Wu: can we mitigate with routing for now? route those streaming requests to a non-quant variant or to sync pool temporarily?

Ava Ramos: suggested short-term mitigations:
- add routing rule: streaming /chat-gen -> redwood-large (non-quant) for 10% of traffic (canary)
- enable aggressive prefix caching for repeated convo prefixes
- scale dedicated pool +1 node for peak windows (0200-0600 UTC)

Jon Patel: risks for customer renewal? this client uses streaming heavily in product demos. if this recurs next week we should flag renewal risk as 'medium'.

Priya Sen: agree. action items:
1) Eng: finalize kernel selection patch by EOD tomorrow (assigned to @ken).
2) Platform: add routing canary for 10% by EOD (assigned to @jon).
3) CS: prep customer note + mitigation steps and ETA (assigned to @ava)
4) Ops: monitor p99 1m rollup and page if >1200ms for 10m.

Ava Ramos: i'll draft the customer note and ping legal for the wording. schedule a call with the customer's infra lead if we don't see improvement by Tue.

cs-bot: reminder set for 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC to review mitigation progress.

Ken Wu: quick note — the patch reduced fallback probability in dev tests by ~85%. hopeful. i'll update here when staging passes. :thumbsup:

Jon Patel: thanks all — i'll update the renewal tracker to medium risk and note mitigations. next check-in same thread next Mon. :calendar:
